notes.title: Some performance improvements - 22.01.2016
notes.notes: I uploaded yesterday a new version with some performance improvements in the rendering of the pieces. This should reduce a bit the occasional choppiness while playing, and in the menus when selecting the level. If you find issues somewhere else, please let me know!

notes.notes:
Flip now features three [b]leaderboards[/b]:

[/list]

I might add more later, any suggestions? :)

notes.title: Brazilian translation
notes.notes:
Following the steps of the Russian one, we just added a Brasilian Portuguese translation to the game. This one was easier, though, as we only needed to modify the position of some UI elements for the texts to fit properly in the screen.

Let's hope now that some of the 200 million Brazilians will like to play the game. :)

notes.title: Russian translation
notes.notes:
We are adding a russian translation to the game!

It was not easy, as we needed to change several things in the interface for the cyrillic characters to work properly, but we hope it pays off by allowing our Russian speaking, logical-puzzle-game-loving friends to enjoy the game in their own language.

And while talking about translations, a big thank to Enzo (@EnzoPiou) for his invaluable help with the French one!

notes.title: Interested in helping test the game?
notes.notes:
Hi!

Although the game is mostly complete, we are still adjusting things here and there, putting the final touches in the audio, adding some new languages and... fixing some remaining bugs.

We could really use the help of a couple more testers, so if you are interested in getting access to the game right now, in exchange of helping us find bugs and reporting them, please send me a message (you'll probably have to add me as a friend).


Sebastian
